report:
Fresh final marker followup of meta.anchors.content.source_end. Preserved the prior input/output, started fresh, read the full claim and three associated test bodies, and recaptured all prior dependencies: parser tokenization lines 1–57, prose recording lines 139–156, test source helper lines 1–15, BookFixture lines 536–565, and review claim construction lines 175–185. Compared every fragment by path/selector and implementation/test metadata. Only an implementation_references comment in spec.rs changed. Claim, parser/finalization behavior, tests, helper captures and metadata are unchanged, with no removed fragments. The unrelated marker delta was checked against the complete prior assessment below.

The sole ordinary source-end implementation association calls finish_anchor with the current parse input's byte length after all Markdown events. Each parse starts without an active anchor. Finalization takes the active anchor and stores only its own source slice through that boundary, trimming outer whitespace; it cannot extend into another document and does not require an explicit end at EOF. For Sage, captured tokenizer code yields precisely the triple-quoted interior and diagnoses unterminated prose. Prose recording excludes delimiter bytes and saves the owner/source span. spec.rs loops each prose block independently, dedents it with an offset map and calls add_chapter_text with a fresh SpecSource/parser state, then remaps locations to the original Sage file. Delimiters, field/declaration syntax, another prose block and following method syntax are outside that input. The review Claim fragment uses the bounded anchor.content. Helpers involved in this assessment are all captured.

The three ordinary tests cover the full boundary claim. claims_retain_all_blocks_until_the_next_definition_or_document_end checks final Markdown content including a later paragraph and trailing whitespace, with exact content and original-source span equality. an_end_marker_in_another_sage_prose_block_is_unmatched creates adjacent prose blocks, checks exact Unicode rule/qualification content from the first, and requires exactly one no-active-anchor diagnostic at the second block's precise marker slice; this detects leaked active state. sage_prose_rules_have_precise_spans_model_owners_and_cross_source_references separates value/member prose and a later class method prose block followed by envelope syntax. Exact rich multiline value text, source marker/content slices, member/query content and owners and review Claim text establish that surrounding syntax and other blocks/declarations/methods are excluded. The real workspace/book fixtures invoke production inventory loading. There are no TODO or N/A entries.

All aspects remain supported after the comment-only change. No source edits, formatting, tests or workspace build were performed in this followup; executed review start/read, capture comparisons and record only. No requested edits.
